name: campusflow
description: CampusFlow — AI-powered college management & placement platform

scripts.build: npm --workspace @campusflow/api run build && npm --workspace @campusflow/web run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm --workspace @campusflow/api run test && npm --workspace @campusflow/web run test
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @campusflow/api run lint && npm --workspace @campusflow/web run lint
